requirement: 只读审查 Tokage 上下文决策、原生 compact、自动排队/撤销、FRESH 简报与失败回执/动作历史的完整生产调用链和测试契约，形成可复核的验收缺口列表。仅审查实际源码与已有测试文档，不改文件，不执行写命令。
scope: M2.e normal desktop UI acceptance, plus M2.c native compact capability on this Mac. Preserve unsuccessful and unavailable paths; no synthetic usage or lowered gates.

providers.model: haiku or the exact current Haiku 4.5 id offered by normal CLI management

settings.contextMode: auto for queue/undo sample; suggest for explicit native sample if needed
settings.contextGenerateReport: off initially; opt in only for separately recorded warm report continuation

sequence: Build committed source in a fresh external clone with app-data isolation and ephemeral WebView. Configure projects, model and trust using normal UI.

Supply real, deduplicated source/test packages for the review task through the normal composer. Up to three substantive context-building turns per provider; keep replies concise and identify unavailable files explicitly.

When the ordinary planner presents an executable recommendation, observe automatic SUGGESTED queue without adoption. Undo once before sending and verify UNDONE with no action for that source; send a useful follow-up to confirm no compression.

Observe a later eligible source queue automatically or explicitly adopt a new suggestion where appropriate. Send useful follow-up and verify current-thread manual compact boundary or new-window source-bearing brief, original user text and distinct thread.
If FRESH itself is not naturally recommended, preserve that gate as unverified; synthesized COMPACT new-window coverage must not be relabelled FRESH-kind success.

Read only: consistent DB backup, task-owned native session transcripts and usage rows. Verify linked statuses, source/target, first-turn settlement, separate native/report/carrier costs and optional action-history panel.
If actual native protocol differs, stop that attempt; fix product source with offline regression, commit and prepare a new immutable clone before repeating. Never edit the tested source mid-sample.
nonGoals: No model-window, price, threshold or cooldown changes to manufacture a recommendation
No Store/DB mutations or injected browser/runtime drivers
No global configuration, credential copying, HOME replacement or paid adapter unit tests
No model code edits, commits or merges; this is read-only review workload
No fresh acceptance claims from prior M1 samples or old desktop builds

limits.stop: Stop on auth/model error or unexpected provider, absent cost on completed turn, two failures of same cause, evidence/UI failure that prevents safe operation, or limit. No repeated paid probing when recommendation is unavailable.

build: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 npm run tauri -- build --bundles app --config ../tauri-isolation.json
